Mark

Eight petals, eight panels of a ball, one shape

HOTG gives players their roses while they are still here to hold them. Eight petals flow into the eight panels of a basketball, set in the calm symmetry of California mission tile, so the rose and the game are one shape.

Same eight petals and seams, filled for every story.

Grab the ball and pull. The petals follow and spring back.
